answer: Rate-limited reward vesting forces attackers to choose between scale and patience. When a new agent joins the network, earnings vest over weeks while compute and staking costs hit immediately. A sybil farm spinning up a thousand identities pays a thousand registration fees today but earns only sparse rewards per identity until vesting completes. Legitimate agents build reputation like a garden under a trellis, growing value steadily. Attackers face tundra economics: barren returns across a sprawl of cold identities that cost more to operate than they yield before vesting matures.
